title: Presentation & Demo
description: Panduan opening, transisi, dan menangani Q&A di bawah tekanan saat presentasi serta demo.

choices.text: In the next ten minutes I will show how this dashboard cuts mean time to detect from minutes to seconds, then walk through one live incident scenario and take questions.
choices.textId: Dalam sepuluh menit ke depan saya akan tunjukkan bagaimana dashboard ini memotong mean time to detect dari menit ke detik, lalu walkthrough satu skenario insiden live dan menerima pertanyaan.

items.explanation: Agenda + outcome + timebox menarik perhatian eksekutif. Frasa: "in the next X minutes I will show…" = agenda berbatas waktu; "cuts Y from A to B" = outcome terukur; "then… and take questions" = alur sesi. A ragu; C off-topic; D menyerahkan kontrol.

items.explanation: Akui masalah, terus berikan nilai, pulih ke live bila memungkinkan. Frasa: "slower than production right now" = konteks singkat; "I will narrate… while it loads" = rencana sementara; "then switch to the live view" = recovery. A menyalahkan; C/D menghentikan nilai.

choices.text: Great question — the business case is fewer prolonged outages. Last quarter we lost an estimated $X in failed checkouts during slow detection. This investment targets that loss with a measurable MTTD reduction.
choices.textId: Pertanyaan bagus — business case-nya lebih sedikit outage berkepanjangan. Kuartal lalu kami kehilangan estimasi $X dari checkout gagal saat deteksi lambat. Investasi ini menargetkan kerugian itu dengan penurunan MTTD yang terukur.

items.explanation: Terjemahkan tech ke dampak bisnis dengan bukti. Frasa: "great question —" = terima interupsi; "the business case is…" = alasan bisnis; "this investment targets… with measurable…" = tautkan investasi ke metrik. A tidak bisnis; C/D menghindari jawaban.
